title: Streaming SSR: Shell Flush to Out-of-Order Swap
description: Trace how progressive HTML chunk flushing unlocks early CSS/JS fetches before slow DB queries finish.

steps.label: 1. Flush <head> + App Shell (t=15ms)
steps.description: Server commits HTTP 200 and flushes <head> with CSS/JS links plus a loading fallback placeholder.

steps.label: 2. Browser Parses Shell in Parallel
steps.description: While the server awaits a 400ms DB query, the browser downloads CSS, boots JS, and paints the shell.

steps.label: 3. Stream Deferred <template> & Swap
steps.description: DB resolves at t=410ms. Server flushes hidden <template> + tiny inline script to replace slot-1.
